BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Notice of Award

Claimant: Marcus Lee
Date of Birth: September 30, 1969
Claim No: BDA-4471-8812
Date: July 1, 2026

Dear Mr. Lee:

We are pleased to inform you that a fully favorable determination has been reached on your claim for disability benefits. The Bureau has found that you have been disabled within the meaning of the Act since your alleged onset date.

Your monthly benefit amount and the date of your first payment will be set out in a separate statement to follow. Past-due benefits, if any, will be calculated and released after that statement issues.

If you disagree with any part of this determination, including the onset date or benefit computation, you may request review. Please retain this notice for your records.

Bureau of Disability Adjudication
Region 6 Processing Center

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Notice of Disallowance

Claimant: Anthony Delgado
Date of Birth: December 15, 1977
Claim No: BDA-4471-5590
Date: June 29, 2026

Dear Mr. Delgado:

We have determined that you do not qualify for disability benefits on your application filed this year. Based on the medical and other evidence, the Bureau finds that your condition is not severe enough to keep you from working.

If you believe this determination is wrong, you have the right to appeal. You must file a request for reconsideration within 60 days of the date you receive this notice. We assume you received this notice 5 days after the date above unless you show us otherwise.

If you do not appeal within 60 days, this determination becomes final.

Bureau of Disability Adjudication
Region 6 Processing Center

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Reconsideration Determination

Claimant: Priya Ramaswamy
Date of Birth: April 22, 1985
Claim No: BDA-4471-6673
Date: July 2, 2026

Dear Ms. Ramaswamy:

You asked us to reconsider the earlier determination on your claim. A different reviewer, who took no part in the first decision, has looked at your complete file, including any new evidence you submitted.

After this review, the Bureau again finds that you are not disabled under the Act. The reconsideration determination affirms the initial denial.

If you disagree, you may request a hearing before an administrative law judge. Your request for a hearing must be filed within 60 days of the date you receive this notice.

Bureau of Disability Adjudication
Reconsideration Unit

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Office of Hearings
Notice of Hearing

Claimant: R0bert Castiilo
Date of Birth: March 12, 1974
Claim No: BDA-4471-4821
Date: July 6, 2026

Dear Mr. Castillo:

A hearing has been scheduled on your claim before an administrative law judge. Your hearing is set for August 19, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. and will be held by video from your representative's office.

You should plan to attend. If you cannot attend on this date, contact this office in writing as soon as possible to explain why. Failure to appear without good cause may result in dismissal of your request for hearing.

Please bring any additional evidence you wish the judge to consider, or submit it in advance through your representative.

Office of Hearings, Region 6

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Appeals Review Board
IMPORTANT: TIME-SENSITIVE

Claimant: Terrence Boothe
Date of Birth: August 11, 1963
Claim No: BDA-4471-9021
Date: July 5, 2026

Dear Mr. Boothe:

Our records show that the deadline to file your appeal of the hearing decision in your case is approaching. To keep your appeal rights, the Board must receive your request for review no later than July 24, 2026.

If we do not receive your request by that date, the hearing decision will become final and binding, and you may lose the right to further review.

If you have already filed your request, please disregard this notice.

Appeals Review Board

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Appeals Review Board

Claimant: Jenifer Okonkwo-Hale
Date of Birth: May 19, 1982
Claim No: BDA-4471-3356
Date: July 6, 2026

Dear Ms. Okonkwo-Hale:

We received your request for review of the hearing decision after the 60-day filing period had ended. Before the Board can consider your request, we must decide whether there was good cause for the late filing.

Please submit a written statement explaining why the request was not filed on time. Examples of good cause may include serious illness, a death in the family, or a failure to receive the notice. Include any supporting documents.

Submit your statement within 15 days of the date of this notice. The Board will then decide whether to accept the late request.

Appeals Review Board

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Consultative Examination Scheduling

Claimant: Alicia Fenwick
Date of Birth: February 27, 1994
Claim No: BDA-4471-3178
Date: July 7, 2026

Dear Ms. Fenwick:

To help decide your claim, the Bureau has scheduled a consultative examination with an independent physician. Your appointment is:

Date: July 30, 2026 at 1:00 p.m.
Provider: Cedar Point Medical Associates

There is no charge to you for this examination. Please bring a photo ID and a list of your current medications. If you cannot keep this appointment, call the number on this notice to reschedule. Missing the examination without rescheduling may delay or affect your claim.

Bureau of Disability Adjudication

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Request for Records

Re: David Okafor
Date of Birth: June 5, 1971
Claim No: BDA-4471-4409
Date: July 7, 2026

To the Representative of Record:

The Bureau is developing the above claim and requires additional records to complete its review. Please provide any updated medical records, treatment notes, or function reports in your possession dated within the last 12 months.

Submit the requested records within 10 business days. If the records are not available or do not exist, please notify this office in writing so the file can be documented.

Bureau of Disability Adjudication
Case Development Unit

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Benefit Payment Statement

Claimant: Latoya Simmons
Date of Birth: January 30, 1983
Claim No: BDA-4471-8143
Date: July 8, 2026

Dear Ms. Simmons:

This statement summarizes the benefit payments issued on your claim for the period ending June 30, 2026. Your regular monthly benefit was paid on schedule. No changes were made to your payment amount during this period.

This notice is for your records. No action is required. If you believe any amount shown is incorrect, contact the Bureau within 30 days.

Bureau of Disability Adjudication
Payment Center

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Notice of Overpayment

Claimant: Sandra Mikkelsen
Date of Birth: October 14, 1980
Claim No: BDA-4471-7756
Date: July 8, 2026

Dear Ms. Mikkelsen:

Our records show that you were paid $3,412.00 more in benefits than you were due for the period of January through April 2026. This overpayment happened because of a change in your reported income that was processed late.

You have the right to ask us to waive collection of this amount, or to appeal if you believe the overpayment is wrong. If you take no action within 30 days, we will begin adjusting your future payments to recover the amount owed.

Bureau of Disability Adjudication
Overpayment Recovery Unit

BUREAU OF DISABILITY ADJUDICATION
Notice of Fee Authorization

Re: Nathan Ostrowski
Date of Birth: June 23, 1987
Claim No: BDA-4471-1174
Date: July 9, 2026

To the Representative of Record:

The Bureau has authorized the representative's fee in the above claim. The authorized fee has been approved in accordance with the fee agreement on file and does not exceed the applicable cap.

The authorized amount will be withheld from the claimant's past-due benefits and released to the representative. This notice confirms the authorization for your records.

Bureau of Disability Adjudication
Fee Unit

Office of Hearings, Region 6

Records Management
